agent_priors_used: A lane that spends dozens of consecutive cycles certifying its own measurement instrument is usually blocked on an upstream prerequisite; the instrument should be repaired or borrowed once, or the metrology thread parked (prior, not SPIDER evidence).
Deterministic and simulated substrates tend to yield ceiling comparators; comparator dynamic range must be certified arithmetically before treatment arms are funded (prior).

An unsatisfiable control-plane hash-binding defect is an infrastructure prerequisite, not a scientific result, and should be fixed once rather than rediscovered as repeated MEASUREMENT_INVALID across lanes (prior; independently verified here by inspecting scripts/freeze_experiment.py, not assumed from SPIDER verdicts).

Long-horizon autonomous research agents exhibit local-attractor and path-dependence behaviour; a fresh-context reset can select a materially different and higher-value problem than the inherited next_question (prior).

Compile-and-execute and validated plan-caching designs (one-shot compilation to a deterministic blueprint, revalidate-every-hit caching) are a strong external design basin for amortized browser-agent cost and therefore a prior about which designs deserve testing, not SPIDER evidence.
Inherited mechanisms that are wrong can be worse than none, so verification and abstention must be measured rather than assumed (prior; external self-conditioning literature, not a SPIDER result).

Persistence, parameterization and caching only pay when re-acquisition is genuinely expensive; the unconditional cost of obtaining a fresh instance should be measured before persistence is optimized (prior).

allocation.question: Can the already-audited parameterized mechanism carrier be installed into the shipped kernel and promoted through the audited product promotion path with a binding pre-freeze positive/negative certificate - src/spider/kernel.py gains a distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify/UNKNOWN path whose confidence flow is not defeated by the current literal distill() candidate confidence 0.5 versus default execution threshold 0.8; the frozen experiment demonstrates one known-positive executable binding (an unseen-identifier parameterized mechanism executes) and one known-negative refusal (a binding the carrier cannot safely resolve returns UNKNOWN rather than a wrong execution), records the honest counters and the pinned git blob / sha256 of the shipped version for the later four-arm benchmark, and triggers promotion only on independent audit PASS - thereby discharging blocker B1?
allocation.rationale: B1 is the global audit's priority #1 and the flagship's readiness condition (1): without a shipped parameterized carrier there is no SPIDER treatment to benchmark, and the shipped kernel today exposes only literal distill() with confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 execution threshold and no distill_parameterized(). Product is the only lane whose scope includes src/, and the audited experimental carrier already exists in Product's own lane (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064: 12/15 unseen identifiers executed, known-negative bindings refused, honest counters, audit PASS), so this is a promotion-and-qualification step, not new science. The lane's active pre-freeze mandate is a near-duplicate of Runtime's B2 certificate mandate; superseding it removes the duplication and puts the two blockers in separate lanes (Product=B1, Runtime=B2). The four-arm benchmark is explicitly NOT funded here; that remains gated on all three readiness conditions holding together. The known-negative refusal test is material because the product must prefer UNKNOWN over unsafe inheritance.

This cycle concentrates capacity on those three gates and refuses to fund any expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution: Product PIVOTs to B1 (promote the already-audited parameterized carrier into src/spider/kernel.py with one known positive and one known negative, which no packet has discharged and which only Product can do), Runtime CONTINUEs as sole owner of the B2 task-bank certificate (consuming Intel-pinned external substrates, with a bounded-negative/PARK exit that finally closes the 68-experiment C-MEAS-VALID metrology streak), and Intel CONTINUEs the last untested B3 variable (goal/schema in the system prompt) with a mandated close-or-re-scope receipt. The Product/Runtime B2 duplication is removed by handing B2 to Runtime alone. Graph is taken off the C-FRESHNESS four-anchor D1V route that its own last verdict PARKed and is redirected to the newly unblocked C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE authorship-confound test (design-contract v2 now hashes code into freeze, removing the historically unsatisfiable V9 precondition that killed three consecutive packets in that thread). Physics PARKS: the frozen barrier transaction completes under its own design and park clause, but the barrier subthread is already bounded INCONCLUSIVE on this pool/window and the remaining observables lack a measurement-ready substrate, so no new physics experiment is funded until a DEEP multi-host pool or a valid interactive/external substrate exists. Net effect: the factory stops re-certifying its own instruments and starts closing the three product blockers.
